title: Ranjangaon
body: The village of Ranjangaon in Pune is famous for Mahaganapati Temple which is one of the 8 Ashtavinayak temples.

title: Luton
body: Luton is a large town in Bedfordshire, some 35 mi (56 km) north of London. It's a multicultural town with a population of about 200,000. It used to have a straw and hat-making trade, hence "The Hatters" nickname of Luton football club; a couple of factories remain along the Old Bedford Road. Luton later produced Vauxhall cars and Whitbread beers, but little of these remain. Most people only come here for London Luton Airport, a major hub for budget & charter flights. The airport is described below but the focus of this page is the town itself.

title: Pio Duran
body: Pio Duran is a municipality of the Philippines in the southwest quadrant of Albay and is adjacent to the city of Ligao. Its coastline is facing Burias Pass and has a port going to the island province of Masbate.
desc: municipality of the Philippines in the province of Albay

title: Tsumkwe
body: Tsumkwe is a village in remote eastern Otjozondjupa region in a barren area of Namibia formerly known as Bushmanland.

title: Auyuittuq National Park
body: Auyuittuq National Park is a national park in Nunavut. In the Inuktitut language, its name means "the land that never melts". If despite that warning, you're still interested in visiting, you'll experience many terrains of Arctic wilderness, such as fjords, glaciers, and ice fields.
desc: national park located on Baffin Island, Canada

title: Tsodilo
body: Tsodilo is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Okavango-Chobe, Botswana. Tsodilo contains rock art that has been made for over 100,000 years, with around 4500 rock paintings. The site also has the highest peak in Botswana too.

title: Santa Paula
body: Santa Paula is a small town in Ventura County in California. The town was an early center of California's petroleum industry and today advertises itself as the "Citrus Capital of the World".
desc: city in Ventura County, California, United States

title: Pyay
body: Pyay or Prome (Burmese ပြည်မြို့) is a city (pop. 134,861 as of 2014) in the Irrawaddy region of Myanmar.

title: Sussex County (New Jersey)
body: Sussex County is in Skylands, New Jersey, in the upper northwestern corner of New Jersey. It is known for its scenery and outdoors lifestyle.
desc: county in New Jersey, United States

title: Stanhope (New Jersey)
body: Stanhope is a city in Sussex County in New Jersey

title: Crooked Tree
body: Crooked Tree is a town in Belize District, Belize.
desc: populated place in Belize District, Belize

title: Cleveland/East Side
body: The East Side is a district in Cleveland consisting of the areas outside of Downtown that are east of the Cuyahoga River. The district includes several important neighborhoods, including: University Circle – Home to 3 higher education institutions and numerous museums and cultural attractions Little Italy – Traditional Italian restaurants, bakeries, and numerous art galleries Shaker Square – A small neighborhood built along the Rapid rail line with several excellent restaurants. Adjacent to the historic suburb of Shaker Heights.

title: Chilgok County
body: Chilgok County (칠곡군) is a county of 117,000 people (2019) in North Gyeongsang. It was an important part of the country's defenses in the Joseon Dynasty and the Korean War.

title: Wellingborough
body: Wellingborough is a market town and borough in Northamptonshire, England, situated some 11 miles (18 km) from the county town of Northampton. The town is situated on the north side of the River Nene (pronounced Nenn in these parts), most of the older town is sited on the flanks of the hills above the river's current flood plain. Due to frequent flooding by the River Nene, the town was mostly built above the current level of the flood plain.

title: Dagestan
body: Dagestan (Russian: Респу́блика Дагеста́н; Avar: Магӏарухъ Жумхӏурият) is the most culturally diverse republic in the Caucasus, and at the Caspian Gates between Persia and Europe has been of historic significance since antiquity. Plagued by a decade of conflict since the turn of the century, Dagestan has been a safe and attractive travel destination off the beaten path for several years. Sandy beaches along the Caspian coast and the rural wilderness of the majestic Caucasian mountains await in this region not yet overrun by mass tourism.

title: Letchworth State Park
body: A happy confluence of geography and generosity has created Letchworth State Park, a long swath of parkland on the western edge of the Finger Lakes region of New York. The Genesee River has carved a magnificent gorge through this area, including a series of three large waterfalls, earning the park its nickname, The Grand Canyon of the East. It's one of the most spectacular natural landscapes in the entire Northeast.
desc: State park in New York, United States

title: Liannan
body: Liannan is a city in Northern Guangdong region of China.

title: Fjærland
body: Fjærland is a tiny town at the end of the Fjærlandsfjord, an arm of the Sognefjord. In Sogn og Fjordane county. It is a particularly enjoyable gateway to the Jostedalsbreen National Park, and is close to two glacial tongues.

title: Hinsdale (Massachusetts)
body: Hindsdale is a small rural community deep in the Berkshire Hills of Massachusetts. It mostly offers outdoor recreation and camping opportunities.
desc: human settlement in Berkshire County, Massachusetts, United States of America

title: Piney Woods
body: The Piney Woods is the name of the region encompassing east and northeast Texas. This region of Texas often defies traditional views of the state having a mountainous desert landscape or brush-covered hills. Large pines and other evergreen trees cover this area of the state, with forestry and oil/gas mining being large industries for area residents.

title: Portbou
body: Portbou is in Costa Brava and is a small coastal town in northern Catalonia, at the end of the Costa Brava and just south of the French border. Wedged between steep Pyrenean slopes and a sheltered bay, it combines rugged scenery with a pebbly urban beach and a compact port. Once a quiet fishing village, Portbou became an important rail frontier in the late 19th century and still functions as a key cross‑border station..
desc: municipality in Alt Empordà, Girona, Catalonia,Spain

title: Wem
body: Wem is a small market town in Shropshire.

title: Dubai/Jumeirah
body: Within Jumeirah you'll find most of the tourist attractions that modern Dubai has to offer. Nonetheless the majority of its territory consists of residential and commercial areas. This article also covers the Palm and World Islands off the coast of Dubai.

title: San Felipe
body: San Felipe is a city in Baja California, Mexico on the coast of the Gulf of California. It has become a resort destination for Americans, Canadians and Mexicans. Its population of 19,000 (2018) swells by up to 5,000 during peak periods like U.S. holidays.
desc: municipal seat of San Felipe, State of Baja California, Mexico

title: Nsugbe
body: Nsugbe is a town in Anambra East Local Government in South East Nigeria. It is situated at the eastern bank of the Niger River.

title: Clifton Park
body: Clifton Park is a city in the Hudson Valley in the Capital District region of New York. It is in Saratoga County between Albany and Saratoga Springs in upstate New York. Home of one of the largest school districts in the state, it has plenty of attractions, and close access to Albany and Saratoga.
desc: town in Saratoga County, New York state, USA

title: North York Moors
body: North York Moors are a scenic upland area in North Yorkshire. They form a quadrilateral roughly 70 miles / 120 km on a side, bounded to the west by the Vale of York, to the south by the Vale of Pickering and to the east by the sea. Much of the area is protected as North York Moors National Park, while around their rim are attractive small towns. They're easily accessed from the bigger cities south.
desc: moorland area in North Yorkshire, England, part of a National Park

title: Sunnyside
body: Sunnyside is a city of about 16,000 in the Yakima Valley, on the Columbia River Plateau of Washington State.
desc: city in Yakima County, Washington, United States

title: Rome/Trastevere
body: Trastevere is a district in Rome. The district's name derives from the Latin words "Trans Tiberem": beyond the Tiber river. Today Trastevere is one of the centers of Roman night life; rich in pubs, restaurants, clubs. Trastevere has a high population of expatriates and American college students as there are two American universities in the area.

title: Spiekeroog
body: Spiekeroog is one of the East Frisian Islands, in the northwest part of Lower Saxony in Germany. Spiekeroog is car-free and has a relaxed atmosphere. The island offers mudflat hikes, cycling, and beaches.

title: Ang Thong
body: Ang Thong (Thai: อ่างทอง) is a city in the Chao Phraya Basin region of Thailand. The city and its surrounding area are noted for its huge reclining Buddha, courageous heroes, court dolls, wickerwork, drum-making, and double-reclining Buddha.
desc: town in Ang Thong province, Thailand

title: Figueres
body: Figueres is a small city in Catalonia, Spain, with a population of 40,000. It is the seat of the Alt Empordà county in the Girona Province and has a wealth of history spanning many centuries that has been preserved and shown in several museums in the area and in the compact Old Town. Being the last major town before the Spanish/French border, it serves as a fantastic base to explore the upper Empordá region that is awash in great food, wines, and beaches that represent the Catalan culture. It is a stage in the Catalan Way of St. James.
desc: town in the province of Girona, Catalonia, Spain

title: Western Suburbs (Illinois)
body: The Western Suburbs make up a region of Chicagoland, in Illinois.
desc: territorial entity in Chicago Metro Area in Illinois, United States

title: Burton upon Trent
body: Burton upon Trent is a market town of 72,000 people (2011) in Staffordshire, England. Burton is known for brewing, it grew up around Burton Abbey and has been the site of 2 battles.

title: Manta
body: Manta is a major coastal city located in the Coastal Lowlands of Ecuador.

title: Bawku
body: Bawku is a major border town and capital of Bawku Municipal in the Upper East Region of Ghana, on the border with Burkina Faso and near Togo. It is a busy cross-border trading town in the White Volta lowlands of the Ghanaian Northern Plains.

title: Paje
body: Paje is a village in Zanzibar in Tanzania. It is on the east coast of Zanzibar (or actually Unguga) island.

title: South Vancouver Island
body: South Vancouver Island is the southernmost and the most populous region of Vancouver Island. It contains BC's provincial capital, Victoria.

title: Sunbury (Ohio)
body: Sunbury is a village in the Greater Columbus area of Ohio, approx. 18 miles north of Columbus. Although a small village, it has had explosive growth over the past few years and all evidence points to more of the same.
desc: city in Delaware County, Ohio, United States

title: Little Fatra
body: Little Fatra (Malá Fatra - Slovak pronunciation: [ˈmalaː ˈfatra]; also Lesser Fatra, Polish: Mała Fatra) is a karst mountain range in the Western Carpathians in the north-west of Central Slovakia. It lies between Nitrianske Pravno, Strečno, Martin and Zázrivá.

title: Lava
body: Lava is a hamlet in Kalimpong District, West Bengal.

title: Meningie
body: Meningie is a town on the south-east side of Lake Albert in South Australia.

title: Langford
body: The City of Langford is a city of over 35,000 people (2016), and is the business hub of "Westshore", a group of municipalities to the west of Victoria. Visitors would primarily enjoy the lakes and trails which are less busy than similar offerings closer to Victoria downtown core.

title: Khorramabad
body: Khorramabad (also written as Khorram Abad) is the capital city of the Lorestan Province of Western Iran.

title: Bischofshofen
body: Bischofshofen is in the state of Salzburg.
desc: municipality in St. Johann/Pongau District, Salzburg, Austria

title: Burbank
body: The self-declared "Media Capital of the World", Burbank is a small city in the San Fernando Valley of Southern California, in the Los Angeles area. It is the home of the headquarters and primary studios of Warner Bros. Discovery and The Walt Disney Company, and of the animation studios of Cartoon Network and Nickelodeon.
desc: city in Los Angeles County, State of California, United States

title: Watertown (New York)
body: Watertown is a small city in New York's North Country, and the seat of Jefferson County.
desc: city in Jefferson County, New York, United States

title: Balikpapan
body: Balikpapan is a city of 850,000 people (2019) in East Kalimantan. It serves as headquarters for international oil companies, mining companies and related support industries operating in (and out of) eastern Kalimantan. It is a relatively clean city, with clear blue skies, but not much by way of nightlife. The population is a mix, with lots of Javanese due to transmigration, lots of people from Sulawesi, and of course, the locals. The people are quiet and polite, and the pace is slow and relaxed.
desc: city in East Kalimantan Province, Indonesia

title: Tofo Beach
body: Tofo Beach is in Inhambane Province, Mozambique. It has been described as "the next Goa", and while this may be pushing it a bit, Tofo has definitely become a traveller's focus on the Eastern coast of Africa. The reasons are not hard to discern: beautiful stretches of beach, a friendly laid-back vibe, a small but pumping nightlife, great diving and snorkeling and a few good restaurants.

title: Fuengirola
body: Fuengirola is a city in the Costa del Sol in southern Spain that is popular with tourists for its long sandy beach and malécon.
desc: town in the province of Málaga, Spain

title: Letterfrack
body: Letterfrack is a village on the coast of Connemara in County Galway, with a population of about 200. In Irish Leitir means a rock-strewn hillside and fraic means speckled, referring to the bright quartzite rocks. The main reasons to visit are Connemara National Park and Kylemore Abbey and Gardens.

title: Thrace
body: Thrace is a region in the southeast Balkans, bordered by the Black Sea, the Sea of Marmara, the Aegean Sea, the region of Macedonia, and the Balkan Mountains. The boundaries of Thrace have always been vague: the only fixed point is that Istanbul and the Bosphorus stand at its eastern edge. For the last 200 years or so the name has meant the segment of Europe within about 400 km of Istanbul. The ancient Thracian people occupied a larger region, and the term "Europe" was first applied to their lands.
desc: geographical and historical region in Southeast Europe

title: Baclayon
body: The historic town of Baclayon lies 6 km east along the seashore from Tagbilaran city on the Visayan island of Bohol in the Philippines. It was the first town established in Bohol by the Spaniards. Its 16th-century church, the pier and harbor it overlooks, and the elegant and well-preserved heritage houses lining the roads, make the township a charming and idyllic destination.
desc: municipality of the Philippines in the province of Bohol

title: Khardaha
body: Khardaha or Khardah (খড়দহ Khoṛdoho) is a temple town in the North 24 Parganas district of West Bengal. It is a pilgrimage site of the Vaishnava denomination of Hinduism.

title: Moscow/Central-North
body: Moscow Central-North is the part of Central Moscow that's north of the Kremlin, east of Tverskaya Street, north of Pokrova Street, the area within the Boulevard Ring, Krasnoselsky south, Meshchansky south & Tverskoy South raions

title: Boonville (California)
body: Boonville is a town in Mendocino County, California, in the Anderson Valley. Boonville has a population of about a thousand people (2020). The small village of Philo, six miles to the west, is a secondary center of activity when visiting the valley. Navarro, further to the west, just outside the valley, is also a possible destination for those interested in the Anderson Valley (this Wikivoyage page covers the entire valley, not just Boonville).
desc: census-designated place in Mendocino County, California

title: Walnut Grove
body: Walnut Grove is a town in Sacramento County, California. Walnut Grove and the neighboring town of Locke are among the best-preserved historic towns in the state that were settled by Chinese and Japanese Americans during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
desc: census-designated place in Sacramento County, California, United States

title: Louiseville
body: Louiseville is a municipality of the Maskinongé Regional county municipality (MRC), in Mauricie, in Quebec, in Canada. Every spring and fall, hundreds of thousands of migratory birds stop off by landing on Lac Saint-Pierre (and its tributaries) and on the surrounding land, many of which are flooded during the snowmelt period.

title: Walsrode
body: Walsrode is a town of 30,000 people (2021) on the Lüneburg Heath in North Germany. The city is known nationally for the Weltvogelpark Walsrode , the world's largest bird park.
desc: municipality in Lower Saxony of Germany

title: Mawlamyine
body: Mawlamyine (also spelled also spelled Mawlamyaing) or Moulmein (Burmese မော်လမြိုင်မြို့) is the capital of Mon State in Southeastern Myanmar.
